tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: gnam chos thugs kyi gter kha snyan brgyud zab mo'i skor las bde chen zhing gi sgrub thabs 'don cha'o:
gu ru dhe wa ḍā ki nī:
'od dpag med pa sgrub pa ni: dkyil 'khor med cing gtor ma med:

na mo: dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa ba gsum: skyabs gnas rnams la skyabs su mchi: 'gro kun sangs rgyas la 'god phyir: byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do: ka dag klong nas sprul pa yi: gnam sa gang ba'i mchod pa'i sprin: sman gtor rak+ta lha mor bcas: zad med gyur cig pū dza ho: me tog chu skyes pad+ma'i steng: de nang rang nyid sems dpa' dkar: mdun du pad+ma zla gdan la: 'od dpag med mgon sku mdog dmar: zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag steng: lhung bzed 'dzin cing chos gos gsol: skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa la: g.yas su 'jig rten dbang phyug dkar: zhal gcig phyag bzhi thal sbyar dang: g.yas g.yon phreng ba pad+ma 'dzin: bzhengs pa'i stabs kyis pad zlar bzhugs: g.yon du phyag rdor mthu chen thob: zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog sngo: g.yas g.yon rdo rje dril bu 'dzin: bzhengs pa'i stabs kyis pad zlar bzhugs: sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang: nyan thos dgra bcom dpag med bskor: gtso bo gsum gyi gnas gsum gyi: 'bru gsum las ni 'od 'phros pas: bde ba can nas spyan drangs gyur: hūm̐: 'od dpag med kyi lha tshogs ma lus rnams: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren byin chen dbab tu gsol: skal ldan dad ldan bdag la dbang mchog skur: log 'dren tshe yi bar chad bsal du gsol: sna tshogs pad+ma zla ba'i gdan steng du: 'od dpag med kyi lha tshogs bzhugs su gsol:

hūm̐: bde chen zhing du chos kyi 'khor lo bskor: sems can rnams la rtag tu thugs rjes gzigs: dam bca' zhal bzhes 'gro ba'i skyabs mdzad pa: snang mtha' mnyam gzhag mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo: oṃ a mi dhe wa hrī: badz+ra sa ma ya dza: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: tiṣ+ṭha lhan: a ti pū ho: thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od 'phros pas: rgyal ba rigs lnga spyan drangs nas: dbang bskur tshe dpag dbu brgyan gyur: hūm̐: bdag gis dri ldan dri chab kyis: 'od dpag sku la khrus gsol lo: lha la dri ma mi mnga' yang: sdig sgrib dag pa'i rten 'brel bgyi: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐: hūm̐: ras dkar 'jam dri ldan pa yis: 'od dpag sku nyid phyi bar bgyi: sku la dri ma mi mnga' yang: sdug bsngal bral ba'i rten 'brel bgyi: hūm̐: na bza' mdzes ldan ngur smrig 'di: rgyal ba'i sku la gsol bar bgyi: sku la bser ba mi mnga' yang: bkrag mdangs 'phel ba'i rten 'brel bgyi: hūm̐: rin chen rgyan cha mdzes pa 'di: rgyal sras gnyis kyi sku la gsol: sku la rgyan gsol mi mnga' yang: gzi brjid che ba'i rten 'brel bgyi: hūm̐: yan lag brgyad ldan zhal bsil 'di: rgyal ba sras bcas zhal du 'bul: zhal la skyems pa mi mnga' yang: sdug bsngal bral ba'i rten 'brel bgyi: hūm̐: 'od dpag spyan gzigs rgyas pa'i phyir: me tog mdzes pa 'bul ba na:

bdag ni tha mal lus po yang: sems kyis puṣ+pe dkar mor bskyed: spyan la mchod pa 'bul bar bgyi: hūm̐: 'od dpag shangs mchog rgyas pa'i phyir: dri zhim bdug spos 'bul ba na: bdag ni tha mal lus po yang: sems kyis dhū pe sngon mor bskyed: shangs la mchod pa 'bul bar bgyi: hūm̐: 'od dpag phyag mchog rgyas pa'i phyir: mar me gsal ba 'bul ba na: bdag ni tha mal lus po yang: sems kyis dhī paṃ dmar mor bskyed: phyag la mchod pa 'bul bar bgyi: hūm̐: 'od dpag sku lus bkrag rgyas phyir: dri chab dri ldan 'bul ba na: bdag ni tha mal lus po yang: sems kyis ghan+dhe ljang mor bskyed: sku la mchod pa 'bul bar bgyi: hūm̐: 'od dpag sku bkrag 'don pa'i phyir: zhal zas ro mchog 'bul ba na: bdag ni tha mal lus po yang: sems kyis nai wid+ya ser mor bskyed: ljags la mchod pa 'bul bar bgyi: hūm̐: 'od dpag snyan mchog rgyas pa'i phyir: rol mo snyan pa 'bul ba na: bdag ni tha mal lus po yang: sems kyis shap+da ser mor bskyed: snyan la mchod pa 'bul bar bgyi: hūm̐: tshe dpag sku nyid rgyas pa'i phyir: rig ma rgyan ldan 'di 'bul na: bdag ni tha mal lus po yang: sems kyis rig ma mdzes par bskyed: sku la mchod pa 'bul bar bgyi: oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wid+ya shab+da mu dra āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: bkra shis gtso bo rdzas brgyad de:

gtso mchog rgyal po yungs dkar sogs: bdag gis lha la mchod pa 'bul: tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs par shog: maṅga laṃ ar+tha sid+dhi hūm̐: hūm̐: bkra shis gtso bo rtags brgyad de: gtso mchog rgyal po bum pa sogs: bdag gis lha la mchod pa 'bul: sems can tshogs gnyis rdzogs par shog: maṅga laṃ kum+bha hūm̐: hūm̐: 'dod yon gtso bo rin chen bdun: gtso mchog rgyal po nor bu sogs: bdag gis lha la mchod pa 'bul: bdag ni tshogs gnyis rdzogs par shog: oṃ ma ṇi rat+na hūm̐: hūm̐: kun gyi gtso bo ri rab gling: ri rab gling bzhi gling phran bcas: bdag gis lha la mchod pa 'bul: tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs par shog: oṃ rat+na maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐: hūm̐: bdag gis skyabs gnas tshe dpag la: bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul ba na: bdag ni tha mal lus po yang: sems kyis bdud rtsi'i lha mor bskyed: tshe dpag khyed la 'bul ba na: thugs rjes bdag gzhan thams cad la: mchog thun dngos grub bstsal du gsol: hūm̐: bdag gis skyabs gnas 'od dpag la: gtor ma'i mchod pa 'bul ba na: bdag ni tha mal lus po yang: sems kyis 'dod yon lha mor bskyed: 'od dpag khyed la 'bul ba na: thugs rjes bdag gzhan thams cad la: mchog thun dngos grub bstsal du gsol: hūm̐: bdag gis skyabs gnas 'od dpag la: rak+ta'i mchod pa 'bul ba na: bdag ni tha mal lus po yang: sems kyis mchod pa'i lha mor bskyed:

'od dpag khyed la 'bul ba na: thugs rjes bdag gzhan thams cad la: mchog thun dngos grub bstsal du gsol: oṃ badz+ra pañca a mṛta rak+ta ba liṃ ta kha raṃ khā hi: oṃ: rdo rje'i sku ni sku yi mchog: tshangs dang brgya byin 'gran du med: nam mkha' lta bu'i sku mnga' ba'i: chos kyi sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: ā: rdo rje'i gsung ni gsung gi mchog: che ba 'brug gis do zla med: snyan pa glu mas do zla med: thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs pa yi: longs spyod rdzogs skur phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: rdo rje'i thugs ni thugs kyi mchog: 'gro ba'i don la nges par gzigs: tshangs pa brgya byin thugs kyis kyang: do zla med pa'i bka' drin can: sprul pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: oṃ: bdag ni ma rig dbang gyur pas: 'od dpag thugs dang gang 'gal ba: bshags bgyi badz+ra satwa hūm̐: oṃ: sku yi dam tshig nyams pa bshags: khyed kyi sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: ā: gsung gi dam tshig nyams pa bshags: khyed kyi gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: thugs kyi dam tshig nyams pa bshags: khyed kyi thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod: oṃ hrīḥswā hā: badz+ra satwa oṃ: badz+ra satwa ā: badz+ra satwa hūm̐: e ma ho: ngo mtshar sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas dang: thugs rje chen po mthu chen thob la sogs: sangs rgyas byang sems dpag med thams cad la: rtse gcig gus pa'i sems kyis gsol ba 'debs:
bdag la mchog gi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: snang ba mtha' yas 'grub par byin gyis rlobs:
de nas rtsa sngags 'bring po ni:
oṃ a mi dhe wa hrī:
yang bsdus
hrī:
bsgrang chog pa yin: de nas tshe 'gugs tshe sgrub ni:

hūm̐: bcom ldan 'od dpag med mgon ni: zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dmar: phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag lhung bzed bsnams: zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs: sprul pa'i lha mo mgyogs ma lngas: tshe bum 'dzin cing mda' dar g.yab: 'byung ba'i bcud bsdus lhung bzed thim: lhung bzed tshe yi bdud rtsis gang: de nas rang la thim par gyur: hūm̐: mda' dar shar du g.yug pa'i tshe: rlung gi bcud rnams 'dus pa las: 'ja' tshon ljang gu 'od du 'bar: de dbus rlung gi lha mo ni: zhal gcig phyag gnyis mda' dar ljang: bum pa 'dzin te gar khyug khyug: ljang 'od 'bar ba'i bro khrig khrig: mda' dar lho ru g.yug pa'i tshe: me yi bcud rnams 'dus pa las: 'ja' tshon dmar po 'od du 'bar: de dbus me yi lha mo ni: zhal gcig phyag gnyis mda' dar dmar: bum pa 'dzin te gar khyug khyug: dmar 'od 'bar ba'i bro khrig khrig: mda' dar nub tu g.yug pa'i tshe: lcags kyi bcud rnams 'dus pa las: 'ja' tshon dkar po 'od du 'bar: de dbus lcags kyi lha mo ni: zhal gcig phyag gnyis mda' dar dkar: bum pa 'dzin te gar khyug khyug: dkar 'od 'bar ba'i bro khrig khrig: mda' dar byang du g.yug pa'i tshe: chu yi bcud rnams 'dus pa las: 'ja' tshon sngon po 'od du 'bar: de dbus chu yi lha mo ni: zhal gcig phyag gnyis mda' dar sngo: bum pa 'dzin te gar khyug khyug:

sngo 'od 'bar ba'i bro khrig khrig: mda' dar steng du g.yug pa'i tshe: sa yi bcud rnams 'dus pa las: 'ja' tshon ser po 'od du 'bar: de dbus sa yi lha mo ni: zhal gcig phyag gnyis mda' dar ser: bum pa 'dzin te gar khyug khyug: ser 'od 'bar ba'i bro khrig khrig: phyogs bzhi steng gi lha mo lngas: 'byung ba lnga yi bkrag sdus la: bdag gi bkrag mdangs rgyas par mdzod: phyogs bzhi steng gi lha mo lngas: 'byung ba lnga yi tshe sdus la: bdag gi tshe 'di brtan par mdzod: phyogs bzhi steng gi lha mo lngas: 'byung ba lnga yi bcud sdus la: bdag gi tshe bcud rgyas par mdzod: phyogs bzhi steng gi lha mo lngas: 'byung ba lnga yi 'od sdus la: bdag gi 'od ni rgyas par mdzod: tad+ya thā: ḍā ki nī: ha ri ni sa: ma ma ā yuḥsid+dhi pha la puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye sā hā: e ma ho: rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas dang: thugs rje chen po mthu chen thob dang ni: sangs rgyas byang sems dpag tu med rnams la: bdag gis gus pa'i sems kyis phyag 'tshal bstod: gsol ba 'debs so tshe yi dngos grub stsol:
de nas rtsa sngags rgyas pa ni:
oṃ āḥhūm̐ a mi dhe wa ā yuḥsid+dhi hūm̐: oṃ bh+rūm̐ swā hā: bh+rūm̐
gnyis ni: gang 'dod gcig ni bzlas pas chog:

de nas mdun gyi bcom ldan 'das: 'od du zhu nas rang la thim: rang lus nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon ltar: bcom ldan 'das kyi skur snang ba: gsal stong zung du 'jug par gyur: e ma ho: ngo mtshar sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas dang: g.yas su jo bo thugs rje chen po dang: g.yon du sems dpa' mthu chen thob rnams la: sangs rgyas byang sems dpag med 'khor gyis bskor: bde skyid ngo mtshar dpag tu med pa yi: bde ba can zhes bya ba'i zhing khams der: bdag ni 'di nas tshe 'phos gyur ma thag: skye ba gzhan gyis bar ma chod pa ru: de ru skyes nas snang mtha'i zhal mthong shog: de skad bdag gis smon lam btab pa 'di: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyis: gegs med 'grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol: tad+ya thā: pañcan+d+ri ya a wa bo dha nā ya swā hā:

bde chen zhing sgrub 'don cha 'di// gter blon rā ga a s+ya yis// gter ston thugs dgongs rdzogs pa'i phyir// gnam chos gzhung nas bsdus te bsgrigs// nye gnas kun dgas yi ger bkod// nyes 'gal mchis na lha la bshags// dge ba 'brel thogs 'gro ba kun// bde chen zhing du skye phyir bsngo/ ༈ /smon lam sogs ci tsam bton nas rjes su/ thal mo sbyar la/

oṃ: 'grub par gyur cig rdo rje'i sku ni skye 'chi bral: tshangs pa'i gsung ni skye med rtag pa rdo rje'i gsung: spros bral thugs ni dus gsum 'gyur med rdo rje'i thugs: 'chi med sku gsung thugs dang yang dag ldan pa yi: rnga sgra'i rgyal po 'dren pa 'od dpag med: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las 'grub gyur te: bdag cag tshe dang sgrub pa mthar phyin nas: rlabs chen 'gro ba'i don la spyod par shog:
ces lan gsum brjod par bya ste rdo rje'i tshig go /de nas bzod gsol/
ma 'byor pa dang
sogs yig brgya brjod nas gzhung gi /
de nas mdun gyi
sogs bsdu rim dang*/ shis brjod dge bsngo sogs bya'o//

༈ phyogs dus rgyal ba sras bcas dgongs: tshogs gnyis rdzogs la rjes yi rang: bdag gis dus gsum dge bsags pa: dkon mchog gsum la mchod pa 'bul: rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'phel gyur cig: dge rtsa thams cad gcig bsdus te: bdag gi rgyud la smin gyur cig: sgrib gnyis dag nas tshogs rdzogs te: tshe ring nad med nyams rtogs 'phel: tshe 'dir sa bcu non gyur cig: nam zhig tshe 'phos gyur ma thag: bde ba can du skye gyur cig: skyes nas pad+ma'i kha phye ste: lus rten de la sangs rgyas shog: byang chub thob nas ji srid du: sprul pas 'gro ba 'dren par shog:
sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: ces pa 'di ni sprul sku mi 'gyur rdo rje'i gter mo// maṅga laṃ/// /
